card.name: Benjamin Tomanik
card.shortBio: Product engineer who loves fantasy. Takes full ownership of shipping product and builds things that make sense — without unnecessary bureaucracy.

story.title: My Story
story.description: I am a product engineer from Czechia who loves fantasy and enjoys building things that make sense. I take full ownership of shipping — favoring independence and fast iteration over bureaucracy. I recently co-founded a startup where I built the entire scalable architecture from scratch; from edge technologies like Vue & Nuxt or React & Next on the frontend to the database, infrastructure, and even the business model.

workflow.title: Workflow & Architecture
workflow.description: My workflow is heavily AI-assisted. I like setting up worktrees with AI agents (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, v0) and delegating syntax-level work to them. This allows me to deliver results much faster, while my pipeline ensures that the output is safe for production right after deployment. Of course, I still validate important commits manually.

principles.title: Core Principles
principles.description: I take full ownership of what I ship. I value independence and fast iteration, with a strict focus on results and real impact — over unnecessary bureaucracy.
